import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/market/confirmBuy/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 选购指令
 * - 指令格式：/选购 上架ID [数量] [确认]
 * - 兼容格式：/选购 上架ID*数量 [确认]
 * - 珍宝楼购买按钮直接触发
 * - 带"确认"参数时跳过二次确认直接购买
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const m = text.match(/选购\s+(\d+)(?:(?:\s+|[*xX×])(\d+))?(?:\s+(确认))?/);

  if (!m) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('参数错误：/选购 上架ID [数量]');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '珍宝楼', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const listingId = Number(m[1]);
  const quantity = m[2] ? Number(m[2]) : 1;
  const isConfirmed = m[3] === '确认';

  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, listingId, quantity, isConfirmed, request });

  if (result.code === 'NEED_CONFIRM') {
    const { data } = result;
    const confirmMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    if (data.overpriceWarning) {
      confirmMd.addText(data.overpriceWarning);
      confirmMd.addNewline();
    }

    if (data.shouldConfirm) {
      confirmMd.addText('⚠️ 大额购买提醒');
      confirmMd.addNewline();
    }

    confirmMd.addText(`将购买：${data.itemName} ×${data.quantity}`);
    confirmMd.addNewline();
    confirmMd.addText(`合计：${data.totalPrice} ${data.currencyName}`);
    confirmMd.addNewline();
    confirmMd.addText('确认购买？');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '珍宝楼',
        content: confirmMd,
        footer: [
          { label: '确认', command: `/选购 ${data.listingId} ${data.quantity} 确认` },
          { label: '取消', command: '/珍宝楼' }
        ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '珍宝楼',
        content: md,
        header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/珍宝楼' }]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

  md.addText(displayMsg);
  md.addNewline();

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '珍宝楼',
      content: md,
      header: [
        { label: '返回', command: '/珍宝楼' },
        { label: '交易记录', command: '/我的交易记录' }
      ]
    })
  );
});
